pieces.Text: You may transform into a blood-red giant praying mantis once per day as a standard action, as if using vermin shape II (CL

). In addition to the normal adjustments to Strength, Dexterity, and natural armor, you gain its darkvision 60 ft., grab, lunge, mandibles, and sudden strike abilities, and damage reduction 5/good. You apply the magical enhancements from any sawtooth sabre that you are wielding to the corresponding claw attack and your claw attacks also inflict 1d6 bleed on a hit.
